This dataset contains daily prices and trading volume for 14 large tech companies
from 2010 onward. The plot below tracks adjusted closing prices for four of them.
Adjusted closing prices are the daily closing prices corrected for stock splits and dividends, 
so prices from different years can be compared directly.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

big_tech <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2023/2023-02-07/big_tech_stock_prices.csv')

big_tech |>
  filter(stock_symbol == "AAPL" | stock_symbol == "MSFT" |
         stock_symbol == "NVDA" | stock_symbol == "AMZN") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = adj_close, color = stock_symbol)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Adjusted close (USD)", color = "Ticker",
       title = "Adjusted closing price, 2010 to 2022")
```

**Data source:** [TidyTuesday, February 7, 2023](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/blob/main/data/2023/2023-02-07/readme.md).

Original data: Gower, E. (2023). *Big Tech Stock Prices* [Data set]. Kaggle.
https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/evangower/big-tech-stock-prices (sourced from Yahoo Finance).
